label: Order emails
description: Texts of the order emails: when an order is paid, notification to the shop and confirmation to the buyer; when the admin sets it Fulfilled, the dispatch email to the buyer. The layout is templates/order_email.tpl.php (plain text).

settings.name: notify_subject
settings.label: Subject
settings.help: Sent to Shop settings → Notification emails. {{order_id}} = order id.

settings.name: check_label
settings.label: Payment note heading
settings.help: Printed before the payment note when the payment did not match the cart.

settings.name: refund_subject
settings.label: Subject
settings.help: Sent to Shop settings → Notification emails when the payment provider reports a refund. {{order_id}} = order id.

settings.name: refund_intro
settings.label: Intro
settings.default: A refund was made in Stripe for this order.

settings.name: confirm_intro
settings.label: Intro
settings.default: Thank you for your order. We will let you know when it is on its way.
settings.help: First paragraph, above the order summary.

settings.name: terms_line
settings.label: Terms line
settings.default: Our terms and conditions of sale are available at {{site_url}}
settings.help: Last line of the buyer emails (confirmation and dispatch). {{site_url}} = the site's front page. Empty: no line.

settings.name: dispatch_subject
settings.label: Subject
settings.default: Your order {{order_id}} is on its way
settings.help: Sent when the order is set Fulfilled on the order page with Email the buyer ticked. {{order_id}} = order id.

settings.name: dispatch_intro
settings.label: Intro
settings.default: Good news: your order is on its way.
settings.help: First paragraph, above the tracking number and the order summary.

settings.name: tracking_label
settings.label: Tracking number
settings.help: Printed before the tracking number, when the order has one.
